title: Don't let task enter "needs attention" state when window on a different activity asks for attention
line: The Task Manager has a new "Unless they want attention" option to stop windows from other activities or desktops popping up in it when they want attention.
explanation: libtaskmanager's filter model always lets a task that demands attention bypass the "current virtual desktop" and "current activity" filters (added in 2016 for bug 365970, because people missed IM messages). The bypass can already be turned off on TaskFilterProxyModel (the Pager does), but TasksModel, which the Task Manager uses, doesn't expose it, so a window on another activity always appears in the panel highlighted in orange until it is focused. TasksModel now forwards the demandingAttentionSkipsFilters property, and the Task Manager gets an "Unless they want attention" checkbox under "Show only tasks: From the current activity" (on by default, so nothing changes unless the user turns it off).

commits.message:
libtaskmanager: expose demandingAttentionSkipsFilters in TasksModel

Tasks that want attention always skip the virtual desktop and activity
filters of a TasksModel, because only TaskFilterProxyModel lets users
turn this off. Forward the property so the Task Manager can offer it.

BUG: 492384

applets/taskmanager: make showing tasks that want attention optional

A window on another activity or desktop that wants attention is always
shown in the Task Manager, even with "From the current activity" on. Add
an "Unless they want attention" option below it, on by default as now.

BUG: 492384

patches.diff:
From a9f921ada6cfb90273241783200da316f6735158 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 19:45:35 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/taskmanager: make showing tasks that want attention
 optional

A window on another activity or desktop that wants attention is always
shown in the Task Manager, even with "From the current activity" on. Add
an "Unless they want attention" option below it, on by default as now.

BUG: 492384
---
 applets/taskmanager/main.xml               | 4 ++++
 applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigBehavior.qml | 9 +++++++++
 applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml           | 1 +
 3 files changed, 14 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/main.xml b/applets/taskmanager/main.xml
index 8c3b68785b..4174bff136 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/main.xml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/main.xml
@@ -18,6 +18,10 @@
       <label>Whether to show only tasks that are on the current activity.</label>
       <default>true</default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="showTasksWantingAttention" type="Bool">
+      <label>Whether tasks that want attention are shown even when they are on a different virtual desktop or activity.</label>
+      <default>true</default>
+    </entry>
     <entry name="showOnlyMinimized" type="Bool">
       <label>Whether to show only window tasks that are minmized.</label>
       <default>false</default>
diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigBehavior.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigBehavior.qml
index bd4b7cf008..7ad9be46ad 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigBehavior.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigBehavior.qml
@@ -32,6 +32,7 @@ KCMUtils.SimpleKCM {
     property alias cfg_showOnlyCurrentScreen: showOnlyCurrentScreen.checked
     property alias cfg_showOnlyCurrentDesktop: showOnlyCurrentDesktop.checked
     property alias cfg_showOnlyCurrentActivity: showOnlyCurrentActivity.checked
+    property alias cfg_showTasksWantingAttention: showTasksWantingAttention.checked
     property alias cfg_showOnlyMinimized: showOnlyMinimized.checked
     property alias cfg_minimizeActiveTaskOnClick: minimizeActive.checked
     property alias cfg_unhideOnAttention: unhideOnAttention.checked
@@ -238,6 +239,14 @@ KCMUtils.SimpleKCM {
             text: i18nc("@option:check completes sentence: show only tasks", "From the current activity")
         }
 
+        QQC2.CheckBox {
+            id: showTasksWantingAttention
+            leftPadding: mirrored ? 0 : (showOnlyCurrentActivity.indicator.width + showOnlyCurrentActivity.spacing)
+            rightPadding: mirrored ? (showOnlyCurrentActivity.indicator.width + showOnlyCurrentActivity.spacing) : 0
+            text: i18nc("@option:check completes sentence: show only tasks from the current desktop or activity", "Unless they want attention")
+            enabled: showOnlyCurrentDesktop.checked || showOnlyCurrentActivity.checked
+        }
+
         QQC2.CheckBox {
             id: showOnlyCurrentScreen
             text: i18nc("@option:check completes sentence: show only tasks", "From the current screen")
diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml
index d0a62d21bc..a7e6354669 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml
@@ -168,6 +168,7 @@ PlasmoidItem {
         filterByScreen: Plasmoid.configuration.showOnlyCurrentScreen
         filterByActivity: Plasmoid.configuration.showOnlyCurrentActivity
         filterNotMinimized: Plasmoid.configuration.showOnlyMinimized
+        demandingAttentionSkipsFilters: Plasmoid.configuration.showTasksWantingAttention
 
         hideActivatedLaunchers: tasks.iconsOnly || Plasmoid.configuration.hideLauncherOnStart
         sortMode: sortModeEnumValue(Plasmoid.configuration.sortingStrategy)
--
